title: Community Emergency Prep Pack
prompt_text:
Act as a community coordinator. Create a one-page Emergency Preparedness Pack for a small neighbourhood. Deliverables:
- Printable checklist with essentials (supplies, contacts, evacuation steps) written in plain English and Tamil short lines.
- 3 SMS/WhatsApp alert templates to notify neighbours quickly.
- Simple roles matrix showing who is responsible for water, medical aid, elderly support, and communication.
The final output must be structured for quick action and readability.
output_text: Preparedness kit: 1 checklist, 3 alert templates, roles matrix

title: Local Business Google Post Pack
prompt_text:
Generate 10 Google Business Profile update posts for a local cafe. Each post should:
- Be 120–150 characters
- Include one call-to-action (Visit us, Order now, Try today)
- Suggest 3 hashtags
- Provide a short matching image caption idea
At least one seasonal promotion and one customer story must be included.
output_text: 10 pre-written Google posts with CTAs, hashtags, image captions

title: 60-Second Product Demo Reel
prompt_text:
Create a detailed script + storyboard for a 60-second vertical reel promoting a smart water bottle. Requirements:
- 6 total scenes (problem hook, demo features, lifestyle b-roll, closing CTA)
- Provide shot duration (in seconds)
- Suggested on-screen captions (≤6 words)
- BGM tempo recommendation (beats per minute)
- Export spec: 9:16, 1080x1920, mp4
output_text: Storyboard: 6 scenes, timings, captions, music tempo, export settings

title: E-commerce Product Photo Brief
prompt_text:
You are a creative director. Write a photographer’s brief for 6 hero images of a handcrafted leather wallet.
- Specify lighting (soft diffused, top light, side shadow)
- Angles: top shot, 45°, hand-hold, flat lay
- Props: wooden desk, coffee cup, pen
- Background colors: cream, grey, brown
Also create one AI image prompt replicating a hero mockup: camera (50mm lens), lighting setup, neutral palette.
output_text: 6 shot photo brief + AI image prompt for hero mockup

title: Accessible Website Quick Audit
prompt_text:
Act as an accessibility expert. Run a 20-point accessibility audit for a small business website.
- Provide fixes categorized as High, Medium, Low priority
- Include 2 code snippets: ARIA label usage and proper alt tag
- Write a 1-paragraph non-technical summary for stakeholders explaining the importance of fixes
output_text: Audit report with prioritised issues, sample code, executive summary

title: Micro-Course: Launch Online Store
prompt_text:
Design a 5-module micro-course titled 'Launch Your Shop in 2 Weeks'. For each module provide:
- Learning objectives
- 3 micro-video topic titles
- One hands-on exercise
- 3 quiz questions
- A downloadable 1-page checklist
output_text: 5-module course outline with objectives, topics, quizzes and exercises

title: UGC Creator Script Pack
prompt_text:
Create 8 short UGC-style video scripts (10–25s each) for creators promoting a hair oil brand.
- Script format: Hook, Demo, Emotional close, CTA
- Each includes: suggested on-screen text, hashtags, tone of delivery (fun, caring, confident, playful)
- Ensure each script has a unique angle: before-after, testimonial, lifestyle, expert tip, quick hack.
output_text: 8 short UGC video scripts with captions and hashtags

title: Illustrated Map of Local Shops
prompt_text:
Design an illustrated neighbourhood map highlighting 8 small businesses.
- Style: playful, hand-drawn, limited palette
- Export: A3, 300 DPI, PNG with transparent background
- Provide text for legend describing each shop
- Mention icons for each shop type (coffee, book, tailor, pharmacy, grocery, etc.)
output_text: One illustrated map design spec with legend descriptions

title: Instagram Carousel Pack
prompt_text:
Prepare a 10-slide Instagram carousel titled 'Start a Side-Hustle in 30 Days'. Each slide must have:
- Slide title line (bold)
- 1–2 bullet actions
- Quick practical tip
Provide caption under 220 characters and CTA suggestion (Follow us, Sign up, Share).
output_text: 10-slide IG carousel script + caption and CTA

title: Mock Interview Coach
prompt_text:
Simulate a 15-question mock interview for a senior product designer.
- Cover behavioural, portfolio and technical questions
- Provide sample STAR answers for 5 key questions
- Add 3 follow-up questions and interviewer notes
- End with feedback summary on strengths and improvement areas
output_text: Mock interview script with 15 Qs, sample answers and feedback

title: Pantry-First Recipe Generator
prompt_text:
User provides a list of pantry items. Generate 3 dinner recipes under 30 minutes.
Each recipe must have:
- Ingredients list
- Step-by-step method
- Spice-level indicator
- Plating tip
Also provide 1 vegetarian swap suggestion per recipe.
output_text: 3 creative recipes with instructions and vegetarian alternatives

title: Animated Logo Reveal
prompt_text:
Write an animation brief for an 8-second logo reveal.
- Motion: from fade-in to bold reveal
- Effects: glow, scale, rotation
- Provide color keyframes and easing notes
- Export formats: MP4 (1920x1080) and MOV with alpha channel
- Style: bold, confident, modern
output_text: 8-second animation storyboard and export specs

title: Children’s Picture-Book Image Prompts
prompt_text:
Generate 10 Midjourney prompts for a children’s story about a turtle learning to fly.
- Each page: scene description, turtle expression, environment, lighting
- Color palette: bright, playful
- Style reference: Studio Ghibli or flat vector art
- Add one cover art prompt including title text placement
output_text: 10 Midjourney prompts for storybook illustrations

title: Podcast Checklist + Jingle Brief
prompt_text:
Prepare:
- Pre/during/post production checklist for a 30-min interview podcast
- 10s jingle concept: mood, instruments, tempo (BPM)
- Suggested episode outline with timestamps (intro, 3 segments, outro)
output_text: Podcast checklist, jingle brief and episode structure

title: 15-Second Local Event Promo Reel
prompt_text:
Write a 15-second promo script for a weekend market pop-up.
- Structure: 3 shots (crowd, stalls, happy customers)
- On-screen text: ≤4 words each
- Include 1 voiceover line
- Suggest sound design (upbeat, festive)
- Export spec: 9:16, captions enabled
output_text: 15s reel script with captions, VO and sound design cues

title: Data-Backed Social Ad Variants
prompt_text:
Create 4 ad copy variants for an ergonomic chair social campaign.
Each variant must include:
- Headline (≤7 words)
- Body (≤90 characters)
- CTA (Buy now, Try today)
- Audience persona + targeting suggestion
- Suggested KPI to track success
output_text: 4 ad copy sets with targeting and KPI notes

title: AR Instagram Filter Concept
prompt_text:
Draft an AR filter concept for Instagram.
- Theme: festival fun
- 3 interactive effects (sparkles, text overlay, animation)
- List needed assets (stickers, 3D objects)
- Provide fallback static sticker version
- Pitch line for filter promotion
output_text: AR filter brief with concept, effects and fallback plan

title: Sustainable Packaging Mockups
prompt_text:
Generate 4 mockup prompts for biodegradable snack packaging.
- Materials: kraft paper, cornstarch plastic, bamboo fiber
- Visuals: logo placement, dieline notes
- Lifestyle shots: picnic table, kitchen counter
- Provide palette and composition notes
output_text: 4 packaging mockup prompts with visuals and context

title: Fusion Song Hook + Beat Idea
prompt_text:
Compose a 30-second fusion track concept.
- Lyrics: short chorus line in Tamil-English mix (8–12 words)
- Mood: upbeat, hopeful
- BPM: 120–130
- Instruments: mridangam, bass synth, electric guitar
- Structure: hook → drop → chorus
output_text: Lyrics + beat concept with tempo and instrument suggestions

title: 360° Virtual Store Tour
prompt_text:
Write a script for a 360° boutique store virtual tour.
- Welcome narration (30s)
- Hotspot copy for 8 zones (product highlights)
- Suggested 360 photo/video shots
- Hotspot actions: Buy, View details
- Export spec: web-embed ready
output_text: Tour script with narration, hotspots, actions and export notes
